name: Clock skew and crystal timing fingerprint
plain: Measures tiny clock speed differences between a device's timers.
meaning: Each device has slightly different oscillator frequencies. Comparing performance.now, Date, requestAnimationFrame and server timestamps over many seconds yields a device-specific drift signature, researched as time-based fingerprinting.

steps: Compute drift ratio against server clock

limits.headline: Can compare your device clocks over many seconds to tell it apart
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens while the page stays open for some seconds
can: Compare several clocks, such as the page timer, the date and screen refresh
Compare them with the site's server time
Build a device number from tiny speed differences
cannot: Work in the first moments of a visit, since it needs many seconds
Know who you are by itself
limits.reach_label: Silent, while the page stays open

story.what_it_is: A script measures tiny speed differences between your device's clocks to make a hardware ID.
story.for_you: You never see it. Every device has tiny flaws in its clock chips. A page can measure those flaws over a few seconds and get a number that stays about the same for your device.
story.for_makers: It works even when software signals are hidden or randomized, since it comes from the hardware itself. Researchers have shown it can separate nearly identical phones. Browsers fight it by blurring timers.

use_cases.example: A research team shows that two phones of the same model can be told apart by clock skew.
An ad tracker could use clock skew to recognize one device across apps and sites.
A bank looks for a hardware trait to link a login to a stolen or cloned device.
A game with strict anti cheat checks for devices reused by a banned player.
A cookie free counter uses clock skew to count unique devices.
A browser maker adds noise to timers so these tricks lose accuracy.
A ticket site tries to find a scalper using one laptop with many fake browsers.

risks: Hard to hide a hardware trait

technical_bounds: Needs seconds to minutes and low noise, less reliable on mobile

value.abuse: Device-bound identification not reset by clearing cookies
